body:
There have been a lot of great Lower East Side TwoWheelTuesdays this year, but the weather looked amazing for mid-October, so a bunch of Gotham DOC members decided to check out Le Lotus Bleú Cafe on Allen Street. 

Piers and Robert were out on their twin black SportClassics. 

![](https://nyducati.hidden-silence-47e4.workers.dev/media/images/da3ed548-be49-42ce-8793-c1ec6359a276-72c0c85b5cf5c43c40961d59615d28d2df2257984a6fbedebcc1ce73360b9587.webp)

Albert and Walter were also down on their twin TriColore V4s's twinning in full red, white and green regalia. 

![](https://nyducati.hidden-silence-47e4.workers.dev/media/images/img-9807-87643b10c28bb688932cee3b7f560f73d0513389ce140908a164f6a6276b35e2.webp)

It was a beautiful evening and great to hang out with the Gotham crew and meet some new two wheeled New Yorkers! 

![](https://nyducati.hidden-silence-47e4.workers.dev/media/images/img-9807-87643b10c28bb688932cee3b7f560f73d0513389ce140908a164f6a6276b35e2.webp)
